text:
emily: Quick sync — Multi-Embed Streaming went GA last night. Need to decide prioritization for next two sprints: bug hotfixes vs UX enhancements. A few customers saw batching/regression issues.

raj: Can we get concrete numbers on impact? which customers, severity?

tori: Support: 5 distinct accounts filed errors, 2 are revenue-impacting (Customer B + C). Error spikes ~0.8% of requests last 6h, p50 latency +30ms on affected flows.

miguel: Root cause looks like KV-cache eviction at sequence boundaries when batch sizes vary. I have a small PR that pins the cache window and avoids eviction thrash — PR #413: https://git.redwood/pr/413 (small change).

aj: Estimate to ship that patch: 2 engineers, ~3-4 dev days total. We should canary first to avoid surprise. If we prioritize this, we pull 40% eng capacity from the planned refactor.

olivia: UX asks we're hearing: surface "batching" knob in Console + clearer error messaging. Mock is trivial (~3 design days), dev to wire ~2-3 days. Low risk but not zero.

raj: Proposed plan: Sprint N (this sprint) = bug patch + canary + observability dashboards (error breakdown by customer + batch-size). Sprint N+1 = UX knob + outreach + polishing. For Customer B/C offer a hotfix + guidance.

emily: Acceptance criteria for the bug-first route: error rate <0.1% for affected endpoints, p50 latency within 10ms of baseline, and no embeddings accuracy regression on our eval set. Also require canary for 10% traffic for 24h with metrics green before wide rollout.

miguel: I'll land PR and open a canary deploy tomorrow morning. Rollout command I plan to use: `redwood canary deploy --model=multi-embed --pct=10 --duration=24h`

deploy-bot: canary started by miguel at 1915013000 — multi-embed @10% — status: in_progress

tori: I'll draft the customer note with workaround: set batching=off for critical paths. Will collect their evaluation prompts so we can run targeted regressions.

aj: +1. If canary shows any signal we have a rollback play: immediate drop to 0% and pin previous model variant. Also prepare a tracing hook to capture KV-cache churn.

olivia: I'll deliver a staging mock of the batching knob and a short copy change for the error modal by EOD.

raj: I'll update the roadmap and the milestones doc (link to internal doc) and notify sales/support prioritization. Need final call by 4pm PT to lock sprint scope.

emily: Decision for now: bug-first. @miguel proceed with PR and canary, @olivia mock the knob, @tori prep comms and workarounds. Tag updates here and paste smoke-run numbers. :thumbsup: :sparkles:
